headline: French Services Sector Contracts in October at Sharpest Pace Since May
summary: The French services sector contracted at its sharpest pace since May according to October PMI survey data, highlighting ongoing weakness in the euro area's second-largest economy.
why: Purchasing Managers' Index metrics serve as leading economic indicators of service sector output, business spending, and employment conditions in France.

impacts.name: French Economy
impacts.why: French service sector contracted in October at the fastest pace seen since May.
